text: [bitter] I... underestimated this fleet. Damn it...
[shocked] Impossible... our fleet, brought down in a place like this?!
[menacing] I'll remember this. This humiliation... I will repay it.
[panicked] Retreat! All ships, retreat! That's enough for today!
[defiant] Fall back! This is a withdrawal, not a defeat!
[urgent] Captain's orders — warp! Get out of this sector, now!
